title: Her Little Plant
lines: Her sister sets a pot on the step.
A little plant sits up in her pot.
Then a big pig runs past and bumps it.
The pot lands under the step in mud.
Pam and her sister fill it back up.
Dad hands them a cup to help.
After that, they pat the mud in.
Her plant sits safe in the corner.

questions.ask: What knocked the pot off the step?
questions.listenFor: A big pig that ran past. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: Who filled the pot back up?
questions.listenFor: Pam and her sister. Dad only handed them a cup - listen for that.

questions.ask: Why do you think they put the plant in the corner?
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. No pig can bump it over there.
